t: Relationship Strength Estimator: a plain-language overview (Signature)
title: Relationship Strength Estimator: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Relationship Strength Estimator does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature strength method scores every connection with its criteria shown: frequency, recency, specificity, corroboration — each contributing openly to the final band. Duplicated sources count once. The archive's links wear their strength honestly.
demo:
# Relationship Strength Estimator - runnable demo (JAH-ATK197S-000001)
RANK = 1
SIG = True
RELS = [('Ann', 'Bob', 12, 0.9, 0.8, ['s1', 's2', 's3']), ('Ann', 'Cat', 2, 0.3, 0.4, ['s1']), ('Bob', 'Dan', 5, 0.6, 0.9, ['s2', 's4'])]  # (a, b, freq, recency_0_1, specificity_0_1, sources)
W = {"freq": 0.3, "recency": 0.2, "specificity": 0.3, "corroboration": 0.2}
def score(r):
    a, b, freq, rec, spec, srcs = r
    f = min(1.0, freq/10.0)
    c = min(1.0, len(set(srcs))/3.0)
    s = W["freq"]*f + W["recency"]*rec + W["specificity"]*spec + W["corroboration"]*c
    band = "strong" if s >= 0.7 else "moderate" if s >= 0.45 else "weak" if s >= 0.25 else "tenuous"
    return round(s, 3), band
for r in RELS:
    s, band = score(r)
    print("[%-8s %.3f] %s <-> %s" % (band.upper(), s, r[0], r[1]))
    if RANK >= 2: print("    freq=%d recency=%.2f specificity=%.2f sources=%d" % (r[2], r[3], r[4], len(set(r[5]))))
if RANK >= 3:
    print("relationships scored:", len(RELS))
if SIG:
    print("Signature lineage stamp: JAH-SIG-STR-" + "JAH-ATK197S-000001")
print("record:", "JAH-ATK197S-000001", "OK")
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
